subject: DPA redline, hosting sequencing & Order Form timing (GreenLabs)
messages:
From: Sarah Gold <sarah.gold@greenlabs.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@greenlabs.com
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redlines & hosting sequencing for Order Form - GreenLabs

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to move forward. Attached is our initial redline to the DPA (GreenLabs_DPA_redlines_v1.docx). A few specific asks from Legal/InfoSec:

- Confirm controller/processor mapping in the MSA (we marked a few sections we think need to be explicit)
- SCCs: we annotated where we need the latest EU SCC clauses and a signing plan
- Transfer Impact Addendum: because we'll be onboarding EU customer data first, we need the pathway documented (KMS routing, on-prem options, and exporter/processor roles)

Practical question: we want to align the order form signature with a short legal review window. Can you share Redwood's proposed sequencing (legal review -> order form signature -> DocuSign) and estimated timelines? If possible, GreenLabs prefers to complete legal redline agreement by end of week (Sep 24) so we can close prior to quarter end.

Sarah
Sarah Gold
Head of Contracts, GreenLabs
Attachments: GreenLabs_DPA_redlines_v1.docx

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Gold <sarah.gold@greenlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines & hosting sequencing for Order Form - GreenLabs

Hi Sarah — thanks for the redline and the clear asks. I've looped in Laura from legal and Ben from commercial so we can coordinate sequencing and the Order Form timing. Proposed plan below:

1) Legal review & technical clarifications (Laura + InfoSec): target 48 business hours from receipt (we'll prioritize given your quarter timeline).
2) Final DPA sign-off and inline acceptance (if small edits remain) — agree sign-off by Sep 24 if legal confirms.
3) Order Form staging in DocuSign and commercial signature — we can stage while legal finalizes redline so signatures can happen same day sign-off is confirmed.

I'll get Ben to confirm any commercial dependencies (discount/pricing windows) and Laura to confirm any non-negotiable language on SCCs / transfer addendum.

Alex
Alex Martinez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Sarah Gold <sarah.gold@greenlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines & hosting sequencing for Order Form - GreenLabs

Hi all,

Thanks for the heads-up, Alex — and thanks Sarah for the redline. I reviewed GreenLabs_DPA_redlines_v1 and attached DPA_Laura_comments_tracked.docx with suggested edits. High-level notes:

- SCCs: we need to ensure the latest (2021) EU Standard Contractual Clauses are referenced; I've proposed a short exhibit that points to the exact SCC template and signature flow.
- Roles & Responsibilities: several of your redlines shift obligations to Redwood that are traditionally controller obligations. We can accept limited clarifications but cannot adopt full controller duties for retention/erasure outside the agreed service scope. See section 2.1 — suggested language included.
- Transfer Impact Addendum: given EU-first onboarding, we should attach a Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) that documents exporter/responsibility mapping and KMS routing (customer-managed key recommended for regulated data).
- KMS Options: two pragmatic paths: (a) customer-managed KMS in supported cloud region (preferred for GreenLabs), or (b) isolated tenant key with Redwood-managed KMS plus contractual restrictions. If GreenLabs needs on-prem key, we will need SOW addendum and a 6–8 week implementation runway.

Timelines: I can complete a tracked-change version within 24 hours. If GreenLabs can accept the TIA approach and the KMS option (a) we can target sign-off by end of day Sep 24. If there are substantial pushbacks on controller vs processor language we may need a short escalation to Legal Ops (Ben — FYI).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Legal
Attachments: DPA_Laura_comments_tracked.docx
Related Doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GxExampleDriveLink-DPA

From: Sarah Gold <sarah.gold@greenlabs.com>

Subject: Re: DPA redlines & hosting sequencing for Order Form - GreenLabs

Thanks Alex and Laura — that plan works for us.

A few quick confirmations:
- We are happy to accept the TIA approach and will opt for the customer-managed KMS in the EU region (option a).
- We will review Laura's tracked changes when you send them; if everything looks reasonable we agree to aim for Sep 24 sign-off.
- Please stage the Order Form in DocuSign so we can sign immediately once legal confirms — I've attached the latest Order Form draft for your reference (GreenLabs_OrderForm_v3.pdf).

I'll confirm internally if any additional procurement approvals are required and loop back before end of day Sep 23. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Gold
Head of Contracts, GreenLabs
